bio_variants: Moreton Island's highest point at 280 m, reputedly the highest stabilised coastal sandhill in the world.
Walk up the sandhill that tops Moreton Island at 280 m, reputedly the world's highest of its kind.
notes: Hours are estimates. Walk length and trailhead unverified.
